sources.title: DeepFakeGuard: Real-Time Deepfake Video Detection Leveraging Celeb-DF ...
sources.snippet: DeepFakeGuard has been pre-trained on a wide variety of datasets primarily focused on the Celeb-DF dataset with high-quality and challenging-to-detect deepfake content. This provides the system with flexibility and precision for multiple applications such as short-form broadcast, high-definition video streams, and live streams.
